jobs.title: Linux Embedded Development Expert
jobs.description: Requires 10+ years of experience. 10+ years of hands-on low-level systems or Linux kernel development, including at least 5 years working directly in kernel space (drivers, subsystem code, or kernel-adjacent infrastructure) Proficiency in C; working knowledge of C++ Demonstrated expertise in at least one major Linux kernel subsystem (memory management, block/IO layer, device drivers, or high-performance networking); surface-level exposure does not qualify
